objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, translated, invalidated, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name including document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive four-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in its status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate when validity expires.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are kept before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of the document for translation.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons within a guideline framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific document properties maintained automatically or by the user.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose in document properties.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user involved in creating, editing, reviewing, releasing, acknowledging, translating, or receiving information about documents and requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned authorizations, distribution, reader access, archive access, or role membership.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered document role that signs creation in the first workflow step and can create document types and Change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Document role with personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Document role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Document role responsible for the document and its content and for deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Document role that can view approved objects and can take note of documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Document role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process used for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants during workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release process tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, document release, validity extension, Change proposals, acknowledgement, or processing results.

objs.name: signature_documentation
objs.description: System documentation of individual participant signatures for each released version.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, revision, release, reactivation, or as the last valid approved version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents after other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for document distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation that a distributed document has been taken note of by a recipient.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard populated based on distribution groups and listing documents relevant to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that must be checked and released before visibility in the corresponding login language.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Link from a document to Master data or other documents, or from a local document to an original document.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data item that can be linked to documents through document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties to link or qualify documents.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties to link or qualify documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be automatically linked with documents already in the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data, such as IT applications, that can be automatically linked with documents.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of User Groups or persons who are informed about release or requested to acknowledge a document.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution in the system: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the document templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploaded external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific document metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version of the document on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change the content or properties of a released document resulting in a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations through document property editing.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process through document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Reviewer completes the review workflow task positively or rejects it.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Releaser completes the release workflow task positively or rejects it.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Cancel workflow for all subsequent participants after first rejection during review or release with multiple users.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs users involved of status, workflow tasks, release, validity extension, Change proposals, or acknowledgement by e-mail.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participant completes task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature_documentation
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Create a new version of a document due to revision, changes, attachment changes, Change proposal implementation, or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting the document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete Change proposals so they are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the document Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised new version is released or when suspension was declared on the basis of the validity check.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document in the system.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing a request for AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, set the last valid approved version to Out of force, revoke rights except archive group, and retain the request for documentation.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request for reactivation confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new version and restoring properties, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: release_reactivated_document
evts.description: Release the reactivated document in accordance with the defined release process.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail from persons and User Group users maintained for acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the current document version with workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons maintained in the Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: populate_dashboard
evts.description: Populate role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports or searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to an original document or maintain references used to link documents to Master data or other documents.
